JOB_ROLES.title: AI/ML Engineer
JOB_ROLES.summary: Build intelligent capabilities, evaluation pipelines, and machine learning models for EBEXTA’s verified bilateral intelligence platform. (Available for Full-time and Internships)
JOB_ROLES.overview: As an AI/ML Engineer at EBEXTA, you will work on the core intelligence layer that powers our bilateral matching platform. Open for both full-time engineers and high-curiosity student or graduate interns, you will build and optimize machine learning models, retrieval systems, and LLM-driven inference pipelines that process structured and unstructured business signals to produce verified buyer-seller counterpart recommendations with high confidence.
responsibilities: Develop and integrate machine-learning and AI capabilities into EBEXTA products
Work with structured and unstructured business data across diverse industry categories
Build systems for company classification, intent ranking, similarity recommendation, and predictive scoring
Improve model accuracy, reliability, latency, and inference efficiency
Work with modern APIs, LLMs, embedding architectures, and vector search systems
Develop automated evaluation benchmarks and validation pipelines for AI outputs
Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to ship features into production
Convert real-world business requirements into practical, high-performance AI solutions
requirements: Strong programming proficiency in Python and familiarity with modern development workflows
Solid foundation in Machine Learning and Deep Learning fundamentals
Hands-on understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and embeddings
Experience working with RESTful APIs, data serialization, and integration
Proficiency in SQL and relational/non-relational data processing
Familiarity with Git, version control, and collaborative code review
Strong problem-solving ability and attention to model reliability and edge cases
niceToHave: Experience with TypeScript, Node.js, or full-stack Python frameworks (FastAPI)
Familiarity with vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, or similar)
Experience evaluating LLM hallucination and structuring schema-validated outputs
Prior contributions to open-source AI projects or technical research
learnings: Practical production deployment of generative AI and embedding search at scale
Architecting verifiable AI systems where accuracy is strictly auditable
Cross-functional collaboration with sales, product, and data engineers
Building zero-to-one intelligence features directly impacting active users
Dedicated mentorship for interns with potential for Pre-Placement Offer (PPO)
JOB_ROLES.workArrangement: Bengaluru, India (Hybrid: office collaboration with flexible remote days)

JOB_ROLES.title: Sales Representative
JOB_ROLES.summary: Drive high-impact B2B technology sales conversations, qualify inbound and outbound demand, and conduct live product demonstrations for founders and revenue leaders. (Available for Full-time and Internships)
JOB_ROLES.overview: EBEXTA is seeking a high-energy Sales Representative (available as Full-time or Internship) to champion our verified bilateral intelligence platform to founders, business owners, and sales teams across India. This is consultative B2B partnership: you will engage in strategic consultative discussions, map business growth challenges, and show revenue decision-makers how verified counterpart matching transforms their sales pipeline.
responsibilities: Identify potential EBEXTA customers across B2B technology, agency, services, and industrial sectors
Understand prospects’ core business, revenue-generation bottlenecks, and customer acquisition challenges
Demonstrate EBEXTA’s bilateral intelligence value clearly through tailored presentations and product walkthroughs
Conduct outbound prospecting and qualify inbound sales inquiries
Identify key decision-makers (Founders, CEOs, Heads of Sales/Growth) and initiate contact
Schedule and deliver consultative product demonstrations
Maintain diligent prospect follow-ups and navigate opportunities through the sales cycle
Record sales activity, pipeline progress, and customer notes accurately in the CRM
Gather frontline customer feedback and communicate market demands to the product engineering team
Achieve and exceed monthly and quarterly qualified opportunity and revenue targets
requirements: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (additional Indian languages a plus)
Strong passion for B2B technology sales, SaaS, and business intelligence
High comfort level engaging in consultative conversations with founders and senior leaders
Basic understanding of sales pipelines, lead qualification, and objection handling
Familiarity with CRM tools and structured sales follow-up processes
Ability to understand technology products and articulate business ROI concisely
Resilience, coachability, and self-driven execution discipline
niceToHave: Prior experience in B2B inside sales, tech sales, or business development
Familiarity with sales engagement tools (Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot)
Understanding of B2B lead generation, prospecting, and cold outreach strategy
learnings: Mastering high-velocity consultative sales conversations with tech founders and executives
Deep insight into how modern B2B companies buy software and intelligence tools
Building predictable sales pipelines and managing deal negotiations
Direct mentorship from leadership on commercial strategy and enterprise sales
Structured internship pathway with performance incentives and PPO opportunities

JOB_ROLES.title: SEO Specialist
JOB_ROLES.summary: Spearhead organic growth and high-intent search acquisition for EBEXTA’s B2B platform through technical SEO, content frameworks, and intent research. (Available for Full-time and Internships)
JOB_ROLES.overview: As an SEO Specialist at EBEXTA (available as Full-time or Internship), you will own organic search as a scalable, compounding customer acquisition channel. You will research how B2B buyers search for suppliers, software solutions, and verified market intelligence, and optimize our platform’s architecture, content hubs, and landing pages to capture top-of-funnel and bottom-of-funnel commercial intent.
responsibilities: Develop and execute EBEXTA’s comprehensive organic search and technical SEO strategy
Conduct deep keyword, entity, and search-intent research for B2B procurement and partner discovery
Identify high-value, intent-driven commercial keywords and map topic cluster opportunities
Audit and optimize website pages, metadata, internal linking, and Core Web Vitals performance
Develop structured content briefs and programmatic SEO blueprints for product and landing pages
Implement technical SEO best practices (schema markup, crawl budget, sitemaps, canonical tags, mobile indexability)
Track search rankings, organic traffic, indexation status, and conversion attribution using Search Console and Analytics
Perform regular competitor SERP analysis to identify ranking gaps and content expansion areas
Collaborate with engineering to ensure new product features are crawlable and SEO-friendly
Focus on conversion-optimized traffic that turns visitors into active EBEXTA users
requirements: Solid understanding of Technical SEO, On-Page SEO, and modern search engine ranking factors
Hands-on experience with Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and SEO intelligence tools (Ahrefs, Semrush, or Screaming Frog)
Proven ability to research search intent and distinguish informational from commercial/transactional queries
Strong grasp of HTML semantics, URL structures, schema markup, and site architecture
Experience creating data-backed content briefs that guide writers and designers
Analytical mindset with comfort interpreting traffic trends, CTRs, and conversion drop-offs
niceToHave: Experience with Programmatic SEO or database-driven content generation
Basic knowledge of JavaScript rendering and Single Page Application (SPA) SEO
Background in B2B SaaS or marketplace organic growth
learnings: Scaling organic search from ground up for an AI-native B2B intelligence platform
Hands-on execution of programmatic content architectures and structured entity modeling
Direct cross-functional exposure to product designers, engineers, and growth marketers
Comprehensive internship mentorship covering advanced technical and programmatic SEO

You will unpack EBEXTA’s product innovations, customer case studies, and industry data into compelling LinkedIn posts, visual carousels, video concepts, and founder thought-leadership content that engages decision-makers.
responsibilities: Develop and execute EBEXTA’s organic social media and narrative distribution strategy
Craft high-signal, engaging written content for LinkedIn and relevant professional channels
Develop educational breakdowns and product-focused teasers highlighting bilateral intelligence capabilities
Build authentic founder and leadership thought-leadership narratives around AI, data verification, and sales tech
Research industry trends, market reports, and news to identify timely conversation opportunities
Concept and script short-form videos, visual carousels, infographics, and interactive content formats
Engage actively with industry communities, founders, and prospective customers in comment sections
Track engagement rates, follower growth, audience demographics, and referral traffic to the website
Experiment continuously with new hooks, formats, and storytelling frameworks
Collaborate with engineering, sales, and product teams to translate technical milestones into accessible stories
requirements: Exceptional written English with a natural, punchy, conversational B2B writing voice
Deep understanding of LinkedIn’s algorithm, format dynamics, and professional audience behavior
Proven ability to explain technical or business concepts clearly without corporate jargon
Experience ideating visual concepts (carousels, infographics, motion graphics briefs)
Basic visual design or video-editing familiarity (Canva, Figma, CapCut, or Premiere is a bonus)
Curiosity about AI, startups, SaaS, and how modern companies operate
Consistency, attention to detail, and a genuine passion for audience building
niceToHave: Experience growing a personal or brand LinkedIn presence with demonstrable engagement
Familiarity with community building on X (Twitter), Reddit, or Discord

learnings: Brand building and organic distribution for an emerging technology company
Executive thought leadership and strategic narrative positioning
Direct collaboration with founders and early team members
Real-world portfolio building for interns across high-visibility tech channels

You will identify high-potential industry clusters, research target accounts, originate strategic partnership opportunities, and build relationships that accelerate platform adoption among trade associations, incubators, agency networks, and enterprise providers.
responsibilities: Identify, research, and map high-growth market segments, industry clusters, and geographic opportunities
Identify and evaluate strategic partnership opportunities with ecosystem enablers, agencies, and trade networks
Generate, qualify, and nurture business development leads through personalized multichannel outreach
Conduct exploratory outreach to business owners, managing directors, and commercial heads
Support commercial discussions, partnership proposals, and alliance agreements
Build, nurture, and maintain professional relationships with prospective partners and enterprise accounts
Coordinate closely with sales, marketing, and product teams to align go-to-market initiatives
Conduct regular competitor analysis and monitor market trends to uncover unmet business needs
Participate in networking events, industry conferences, and online trade summits to represent EBEXTA
Track business development metrics, outreach velocity, and partner conversion outcomes
requirements: Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills with an articulate business acumen
High aptitude for commercial market research, company analysis, and account mapping
Demonstrated interest in partnerships, deal-making, technology adoption, and commercial expansion
Self-driven entrepreneurial attitude with comfort navigating ambiguous zero-to-one challenges
Strong negotiation, persuasion, and relationship-building abilities
Proficiency in preparing clean presentation decks and professional email correspondence
Discipline in tracking outreach and pipeline in structured CRM or project boards
niceToHave: Prior experience in business development, corporate partnerships, or agency account management
Existing network within Indian startup ecosystems, trade chambers, or B2B tech communities
Familiarity with SaaS pricing models and commercial contract structures
learnings: Structuring and executing B2B partnerships and commercial alliance agreements

Internship training in consultative B2B deal formation and executive communications

CULTURE_PILLARS.title: OWNERSHIP
CULTURE_PILLARS.description: We don’t believe in siloed task handoffs. When you take on a project, whether an AI pipeline, an SEO strategy, or an enterprise deal, you own the outcome from inception to customer impact.

CULTURE_PILLARS.title: LEARNING
CULTURE_PILLARS.tagline: Learn by solving real, unstructured problems.
CULTURE_PILLARS.description: The fastest learning happens when you are tackling real market challenges with real users. We provide autonomy, fast feedback, and high expectations so you grow exponentially.

CULTURE_PILLARS.title: EXECUTION
CULTURE_PILLARS.tagline: Move from ideas to measurable results.
CULTURE_PILLARS.description: Speed and rigor are not opposites. We value concise plans, rapid prototyping, clean code, and tangible metrics over bureaucracy and endless slide decks.

CULTURE_PILLARS.title: COLLABORATION
CULTURE_PILLARS.tagline: Tight loops between technology and business.
CULTURE_PILLARS.description: Engineers sit with sales; marketers inspect product analytics; business developers review match accuracy. We build better because our teams speak the same language.

CULTURE_PILLARS.title: CUSTOMER REALITY
CULTURE_PILLARS.tagline: Grounded in verified buyer & seller truth.
CULTURE_PILLARS.description: Every feature we build and every message we send is verified against real business needs. We solve genuine discovery friction for founders and revenue leaders.
